Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4198, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework` for the two findings below.

The environment has no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or pool job ID. `review-4198` identifies this assigned review.

### Requested before merge

1. **Preserve the keyword boundary for probe logging.** `assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps:360` removes the separator before the filename. `PROBEOPEN log.txt` becomes `PROBEOPENlog.txt` during the test, so `\b` does not match. The post then emits `(PROBEOPEN log.txt)` without a dash. The same input with upstream main's script emits `(- PROBEOPEN log.txt)`. Thus a machine name can open a probe log file instead of remaining an inert comment. The [LinuxCNC reference](https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/overview.html#_probe_logging) defines this active comment. Match spaces within keywords without losing the boundary before their arguments. Add a regression test with `PROBEOPEN log.txt`. Keep the spaced-keyword and plain-word cases.
2. **Meet the test suite rules.** `crates/post/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs:1` adds a top-level test binary. The PR body gives no reason for a separate binary. The file also has no Gate map or source provenance line. Current upstream `AGENTS.md` requires both the reason and a map for the owning crate. Put these tests in an existing domain directory suite, or state the required reason in the body. Add the Gate map for `camcraft_post::post::engine` and `assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps`. Name the public LinuxCNC reference and the original fixtures in a provenance line.

### Scope and safety checks

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the post changes G-code. I read the complete three-file diff and the issue #4152 discussion. No earlier reviewer findings exist. I used the laws from upstream main `72890060b53a6dc836e8cee1d928226e11a4d753`.

The local trial merge is `f8789cd0a89c0b03e727d7efbdfe190aefcffe07`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. The merge is clean. The published [named-parameter reference](https://linuxcnc.org/docs/stable/html/gcode/overview.html#_predefined_named_parameters) supports the task guard. No UI, dependency, workflow, build script, or process file changes occur.

Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no recorded `.nc` or `.cl` files or catalog files. The golden suites passed. A line-by-line comparison of the posted corner-probe stream found only the two intended task guards. Hardware execution was not tested.
